description: Show the caller's rate-limit budget per operation class over the rolling 24h window: for each of decide / generate / author / read / keys / admin, the used count, limit, remaining, and reset time. `generate` (LLM rule generation) is the scarce class; browsing and status polling (`read`) are effectively unlimited-but-metered. Check this before a large authoring run — and report remaining `generate` budget to the user — so a 429 is never the first signal. Tenant-scoped — requires an API key.
name: aethis_usage
